# LTX-2 Transformer-Only Local Setup

This workflow is local-only and targets:
- `ltx-2-19b-dev-fp8_transformer_only.safetensors`

Related models used by your other local workflows:
- `ltx-2-19b-dev_Q4_K_M.gguf`
- `ltx-2-19b-distilled_Q6_K.gguf`

Companion files commonly required by the wrapped LTX-2 graph:
- `gemma_3_12B_it_fp4_mixed.safetensors`
- `ltx-2-19b-embeddings_connector_dev_bf16.safetensors`
- `LTX2_video_vae_bf16.safetensors`
- `LTX2_audio_vae_bf16.safetensors`
- `ltx-2-spatial-upscaler-x2-1.0.safetensors`

nodes.title: About Size
widgets_values:
Width & height settings must be divisible by 32 + 1. 
Frame count must be divisible by 8 + 1. 


Running with invalid parameters **will not cause errors**. Instead, the flow will silently choose the closest valid parameters. 

By default, we are using 720p resolution. You can try 1920*1088 if you have a powerful GPU.

Suddenly, he opens his mouth and begins to sing opera in Italian: "La donna è mobile, qual piuma al vento." Rich, resonant notes echo through the space. As his voice climbs in pitch, his brows lift, and his expression becomes more passionate, almost vulnerable. nodes.title: LTX-2 Transformer-Only Generator (wrapped)
PGFX Studio + LTX-2 Transformer-Only (Local End-to-End)
widgets_values:
1. Select local audio in `LoadAudio`.
2. Configure PGFX Studio chain model/settings.
3. Cinematographer drives wrapped transformer node prompt + frame_count per scene.
4. Queue repeatedly in Auto-Increment mode to render scene-by-scene.
5. SaveVideo writes output clips; set a project-specific filename prefix.
6. Transformer model target: `ltx-2-19b-dev-fp8_transformer_only.safetensors`.
7. This workflow is local-only and does not depend on LTX platform APIs.

nodes.title: Run Strategy
widgets_values:
Queue strategy: one queue pass renders one scene in Auto-Increment mode.
Keep queueing until scene sequence is complete.
For lyric-driven context, paste full lyrics into Screenwriter `raw_lyrics_override`.
Director default uses `use_prompt_template=True` for speed and stability.
Enable Director `enable_visual_metaphors` only if you want extra per-scene LLM passes (slow).
ScriptSupervisor is bypassed by default (mode 4) for speed; enable it manually for continuity QA.
If `whisperx` is not installed, Screenwriter auto-falls back to timing-map segmentation from `raw_lyrics_override`.

nodes.title: Frame Rate Note
widgets_values: Please make sure the frame rate value is the same in both boxes

nodes.title: LoRA
widgets_values:
# Using LoRAs
**Ctrl + B to enable**

For the camera LoRA we recommend setting strength = 1

You can use LTX [Ready to use camera LoRAs](https://huggingface.co/collections/Lightricks/ltx-2)




Use a second LoRa only when the details are important in the LoRa. 

## Training
We have made available a full trainer to help you to train your own LoRA. You can [find it here](https://github.com/Lightricks/LTX-2).
